Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Another new recipe for me today and another winner!  #tiktokthanksgivingcontest #thanksgivingdessert #gingerbread  Gingerbread Brownies with Gingerbread Ermine Frosting Original recipe by I Am Baker. Note: The only changes I made to the original recipe were using salted butter instead of unsalted butter and increasing the salt to 1 teaspoon in the brownies. Gingerbread Brownies Ingredients 1 cup (2 sticks) salted butter, melted 1 1/2 cups light brown sugar, packed 2 large eggs, room temperature  2 tablespoons molasses 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon ground ginger 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon salt Gingerbread Ermine Frosting Ingredients 1 cup whole milk 5 tablespoons all-purpose flour 1 cup (2 sticks) salted butter, room temperature 1 cup light brown sugar, packed 1 teaspoon gingerbread spice mix (recipe below) 1 teaspoon vanilla extract Directions Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 9x9-inch baking dish with parchment paper and set aside. In a large bowl, mix melted butter and brown sugar together until well combined. Add eggs, molasses and vanilla and mix until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk flour, ginger, cinnamon, baking powder and salt together. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix until fully combined. Spread batter evenly into prepared baking dish. Bake for 28-33 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is no longer jiggly. Allow brownies to cool completely before frosting. While brownies are cooling, make the frosting. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, whisk milk and flour together. Cook for 3-5 minutes, whisking constantly, until mixture is smooth and thick like pudding. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely to room temperature. Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface to prevent a skin from forming. In a large bowl, cream softened butter and brown sugar together for 2-3 minutes until light and fluffy. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed. Add cooled milk mixture and gingerbread spice mix. Beat on medium-high speed for 2-3 minutes until light and fluffy. Switch to a whisk attachment, add vanilla and whip on high for 7-8 minutes until frosting is smooth and creamy. Spread frosting evenly over completely cooled brownies. Slice and serve! Homemade Gingerbread Spice Mix 3 tablespoons ground cinnamon 2 tablespoons ground ginger 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg 1 teaspoon ground allspice 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom (optional)

Making that viral high-protein crockpot marry me chicken, but with a hormone-supportive upgrade. 🍲✨ When you’re navigating PCOS and prepping your body to conceive, keeping blood sugar steady and getting in nutrient-dense protein is everything. Swapping in chicken thighs gives you extra iron, zinc, and healthy fats, while bone broth brings in glycine and gut-supporting amino acids for that uterine lining.  I left out the red pepper flakes so Mila could eat dinner right along with us, and divided the rest into 8 meal prep containers for easy grab-and-go lunches. 🤍 Ingredients (Makes 8 servings):** • 2.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs • 1 cup organic chicken bone broth • 1 small onion, diced • 4 tsp minced garlic • 1 cup sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped • 1 tbsp paprika • 1 tbsp garlic powder • 1.5 tbsp Italian seasoning • Salt & black pepper, to taste • 1 tsp red pepper flakes (optional — omit for toddlers!) High-Protein Cream Sauce: • 1 cup 2% cottage cheese (200g) • 1 cup 0% plain Greek yogurt (240g) • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 2–4 tbsp warm bone broth from the crockpot Stir-ins: • 2 cups freshly grated parmesan (200g) • 2–3 cups fresh baby spinach • 2.5 cups dry jasmine rice (cooked) Instructions: Add chicken thighs, bone broth, onion, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and seasonings (plus red pepper flakes if using) to the crockpot. Cook on LOW for 6 hours (or HIGH for 3–4 hours). Shred the chicken directly in the pot. Blend the sauce ingredients with a splash of the warm broth until completely smooth, then pour into the crockpot. Stir in parmesan and baby spinach until melted and wilted. Fold in cooked jasmine rice, stir until creamy, and divide into 8 containers! Macros per serving (1 of 8): • Calories: ~560 kcal • Protein: 48g • Carbs: 56g • Fat: 16g Save this for your next Sunday reset!
